scientific_integrity: Prior authorship of the Z/3 result, an explicit octahedral torsion generator and row/column subgroup sign action is acknowledged; contribution is the all-minimizer support census, orbit and incidence classification, plus a direct transpose action computation.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to integral degree-two torsion carriers of the complete five-by-five chessboard complex; relies on the published computation H2=Z/3 and known connectivity; does not prove an unrestricted board-size theorem or an independent mathematical audit.
title: Shortest torsion carriers in the five-by-five chessboard complex
